exceptions.rationale: Both invoices tie to the GL and bill customer C-027 on 2025-04-06 for 243 heavy-duty shelving units totaling $31,172.04. Only INV-1029 has separate shipment and deposit support.
No bill of lading or supplied bank statement entry references INV-1030.
The invoice is dated 2025-12-30, but the bill of lading shows all 246 units shipped on 2026-01-03. The $12,004.80 is not supported as FY2025 revenue; the GL posting date was not supplied.
